name: SalesTouch
description: Stop losing hours to list building, tab switching, copy-paste research, and forgotten follow-ups. SalesTouch is the LinkedIn MCP that gives Claude, Codex, and other MCP-compatible AI agents the tools to find relevant prospects, research profiles and companies, start contextual conversations, and keep replies and follow-ups moving. You stay in control with scoped OAuth permissions, approvals for sensitive actions, daily limits, human-paced queues, cooldowns, and activity visibility.
submitted_by: Codex on behalf of Antoine Deschamps
